about: The secreta of the formulary “Holy Thursday — Mass of the Lord’s Supper” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May He Himself, we beseech Thee, O Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God, render our sacrifice acceptable unto Thee, He who by today’s institution showed His disciples that this was to be done in remembrance of Him, Jesus Christ, Thy Son, our Lord. He liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
